$comment: K9 template check (tools/k9-check.mjs). kind: app | game. allow: items this repo still lacks, each with the reason; they are report-only (a CI warning) until added, then the entry must go (an entry for an item that exists fails).

allow.api-tests: A Windows PowerShell/WPF desktop widget: it serves no HTTP API (it only calls the Anthropic usage endpoint as a client, covered by the fixture tests in tests/run-tests.ps1).
allow.e2e-playwright: No browser UI: the window is WPF, so Playwright cannot drive it; the -Snapshot PNG mode is the visual check instead.
allow.axe-2.2: No HTML page: axe only scans web pages, and the WPF window is not one.
allow.visual-baseline: No committed baseline compared in CI: the -Snapshot mode renders PNGs (docs/widget-*.png are README screenshots), but no test compares them with a stored baseline yet.
allow.coverage-floor: PowerShell has no coverage tool here; the ratchet is the test count $MIN_PASS in tests/run-tests.ps1 (357) plus the UNTESTED count in tests/TEST-MAP.txt, checked by tests/check-ratchet.ps1, a format the K9 check does not read.
allow.el-en-strings: The UI strings are Greek only (CLAUDE.md); there is no English table or switch.
allow.health-ready: A local desktop widget, not a service: nothing listens on a port, so there is no health/ready endpoint to probe.
